scenario.context: A lender is evaluating an AI-assisted application review system before allowing staff to use it. Historical training data contains substantially fewer examples from some demographic groups.
scenario.current_state: The project team has measured overall model accuracy but has not compared outcomes across relevant groups.
scenario.problem: The compliance team wants evidence that the system does not systematically disadvantage underrepresented groups.

constraints.text: Evaluate outcomes across relevant demographic groups
Complete the assessment before production use

stem: Which action best addresses the compliance team's concern?

options.text: Increase the model temperature to produce more varied outputs
Compare performance and outcome metrics across relevant groups and investigate material disparities
Evaluate only aggregate accuracy because the same model is used for every applicant
Deploy the system first and review group-level outcomes only after customer complaints

explanation.summary: Responsible AI evaluation should examine whether model performance or outcomes differ materially across relevant groups instead of relying only on aggregate accuracy.

option_analysis.A: Temperature changes generation variability and does not measure demographic performance disparities.
option_analysis.B: Group-level metrics directly test the identified risk and support investigation before deployment.
option_analysis.C: Aggregate accuracy can hide poor performance or adverse outcomes for smaller groups.
option_analysis.D: Waiting for complaints fails the requirement to assess the risk before production use.

learning_points: Aggregate metrics can conceal subgroup disparities
Responsible AI controls should be applied throughout the AI lifecycle

sources.title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam guide
